shape: 3-portal T-junction (S + E + W gates) with center 5-way + west hub
description: Three-portal arena. CENTER (gxbppo at (3.98, 7.72)) is a 5-way hub joining spawn_east, spawn_south, and 3 spread anchors. WEST HUB (gsr64h) is a 4-way joining spawn_west, m3bnda, fu92td, and center. m3bnda (north of west_hub) and fu92td (east of west_hub) both connect to BOTH center and west_hub — small bridge between hubs.

portals.south: spawn_south at (3.87, 18.88) — gate on the south (high-Z) side
portals.east: spawn_east at (22.63, 7.77) — gate on the east (high-X) side
portals.west: spawn_west at (-22.36, -8.02) — gate on the west (low-X) side

anchors.description: north anchor - bridges center + west_hub (matches m3bnda)
east anchor - bridges center + west_hub (matches fu92td)

traversalNotes: Direct S→E: spawn_south → center → spawn_east. 2 hops.
Direct S→W: spawn_south → center → west_hub → spawn_west. 3 hops.
Direct W→E: spawn_west → west_hub → center → spawn_east. 3 hops.
DISPATCH RULE: center handles S+E; west_hub handles W. n_anchor + e_anchor are detour anchors connecting both hubs.
